items.text: Seahawks placing first-round RB Jadarian Price on IR due to chest injury aggravated at practice; misses minimum four weeks. Signed Velus Jones Jr. from PS.
items.why: Chest injury; official IR placement confirmed by Schefter and team moves.
items.implication: SEA backfield opens further; Charbonnet already practicing post-ACL but listed OUT this week.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining backs (Wilson/Holani/Jones); long-term Price still has upside per Levitan.

items.text: Justin Jefferson listed OUT for Week 4 with ankle sprain. Schefter confirmed Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday.
items.why: Sprained ankle; official designation and Schefter report.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in MIN offense; Addison becomes primary WR.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Jordan Addison vs soft MIA secondary.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN and expected to play Week 4 after missing prior games with hip. Schefter: Puka Nacua is expected to play; reports note possible snap count.
items.why: Cleared full practice progression; no designation; McVay positive comments.
items.implication: LAR WR1 returns but monitor snap limits; Adams/others may still see elevated work early.
items.opportunity: Full route share potential if unlimited; elite talent in favorable spot.
items.conflict: Possible snap restriction reduces ceiling vs full return assumption.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN and good to go for Week 4 after hamstring. Rapoport: Nico Collins is good to go; full participant Friday, no designation.
items.why: Full practice; official clearance via team/PR and Rapoport.
items.implication: Elite WR1 returns in high-implied total vs DAL (top DvP for WRs).
items.opportunity: High target share + favorable matchup; Texans 7th-most implied points.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Week 4. Schefter included in official outs list.
items.implication: NYJ RB work to backups; full snaps available previously after Hall exit.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup elevation (e.g. Braelon Allen path per Berry notes).

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday vs Rams due to hamstring. Also OUT: Dallas Goedert (knee) and Zack Baun.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith; knee for Goedert; official rulings.
items.implication: PHI offense severely depleted vs LAR; Hurts/A.J. Brown/others absorb targets; worse overall unit per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Target concentration on remaining pass-catchers; reverse any prior beneficiary assumptions if unexpectedly active (none are).

items.text: Colts downgraded WR Keenan Allen to OUT (groin) for London game; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine. Terry McLaurin added late with hamstring, QUESTIONABLE and reportedly unlikely vs IND.
items.why: Groin for Allen (Schefter/Rap); late hamstring for McLaurin.
items.implication: IND WR targets to Downs/Pierce/others; WAS without McLaurin boosts remaining.
items.opportunity: Downs already Berry LOVE; further concentration.

items.text: Levitan notes: Great to have Puka Nacua back but speculation on limited snaps. Excellent spot for Nico Collins return (DAL inflates WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL; HOU 7th-most implied pts). Jordan Addison opportunity home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson out. Eagles worse without Smith/Goedert/Baun.
items.why: DvP data, implied totals, role expansion from absences, return caveats.
items.implication: Start Collins confidently; monitor Nacua snaps; Addison smash spot; fade PHI pass catchers relatively.
items.opportunity: Collins high volume + matchup; Addison target share spike; Nacua if unlimited.
items.conflict: Nacua snap limit risk vs full projection.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) went LP-DNP-LP trend; already dealt with cracked rib. Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing—but still long-term upside and eye test positive.
items.why: Practice trend for McConkey; multi-factor role erosion + IR for Price.
items.implication: McConkey risky Q; Price IR locks out short-term, but hold long-term.
items.opportunity: Reduced for both near-term; SEA committee further fragmented.

items.text: De'Von Achane listed OUT; suffered torn ACL in Week 3, ending season.
items.implication: MIA backfield fully opens for season; low implied totals already.
items.opportunity: Clear path for remaining MIA RBs (e.g. Gordon or others) but tough matchups.

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) intends to play through injury as GTD; Shanahan says game-time decision. Listed QUESTIONABLE by ETR; optimistic outlook in some reports.
items.why: Ribs; player comments on playing through similar past injury with padding.
items.implication: If out, boosts Kittle/CMC/Samuel; if in, pain may limit effectiveness.
items.opportunity: Kittle target/route upside if Evans limited/out; Denver allows TE production.

items.text: Berry LOVE Jaylen Warren (@CLE TNF): 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches, Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game. LOVE Jeremiyah Love (@NYG): RB5 utilization, 26 touches last week (more than W1+2), double-digit target share every game; NYG allows 5.1 YPC.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share + favorable matchups and teammate absences.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex starts with workhorse potential.

items.text: Berry LOVE Drake London (@NO): 35%+ TS career w/Penix, 43.5% last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs. LOVE Garrett Wilson (@CHI): no AD Mitchell, 36% TS prior absence; CHI allows 14+ YPR. LOVE Josh Downs (vs WSH): 31% TS last two, 43% RZ; WSH worst vs WRs/slot. LOVE George Kittle (vs DEN): rising TS/routes (27% W3); Evans GTD ribs; DEN 8th-most TE yards.
items.why: Target share spikes from QB/teammate factors + elite matchups.
items.implication: Priority starts/upgrades; parlay lean Wilson/Addison noted separately.

items.text: Berry HATE Omarion Hampton (@SEA): RB27 utilization, 3.5% TS, 25% routes, snaps down to 42%/13% 3rd-down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest). HATE Justin Herbert (@SEA): 44% pressure rate season, SEA 4th pressure/lowest YPA/YPC; bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Poor usage metrics + tough defensive matchups and low totals.
